observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation console with the PS logo on the front, plus a white DualSense-style controller and a power/AV cable bundle.
Photo 0 controller appears to be a DualSense (buttons/analog layout visible) and there is a disc-drive area visible on the console front.
Photo 1 shows the console from the side/front with the controller in front; cables are visible.
No FIFA disc/game case is visible in either photo.
No model revision details (e.g., disc vs digital edition label beyond the visible disc slot area) or serial/region sticker is readable.

read_from: photo 0 (PS logo and PS5 form factor)

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a PS5 console (white) and a matching white controller.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game and accessories.
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc or game case is shown in photo 0 or photo 1; only cables/accessories are partially visible.

risks.risk: Missing FIFA disc (or different game) and/or missing accessories not shown in the photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the FIFA disc (front label) and a photo showing everything included laid out (disc, controller(s), cables, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS5 console + 1 controller only (no game disc, minimal accessories).

risks.risk: Console may be faulty (disc drive not reading, HDMI/power issues, overheating) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the console powering on and loading a game from the disc drive (or system menu + disc read).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: disc drive/console may be defective).

risks.risk: Controller condition may be poor (drift, broken buttons, weak sticks) or not the exact controller included.
risks.proof: Request a video showing controller connected and a quick stick/button test (showing inputs) or a screenshot from controller test screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst case: may need repair).

risks.risk: PS5 version/edition uncertainty (disc vs digital) and completeness of required cables.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the back/side labels and the full set of cables/ports (including power cable and HDMI).
risks.if_unproven: Price as disc-capable PS5 but with cable completeness unknown (worst case: missing one required cable).

proof_requests: Photo of the FIFA disc (front label) and game case (if any).
Photo of all included items laid out (console, controller(s), HDMI, power cable, any extra accessories).
Video: console boots to home screen and loads a disc (or shows disc being read).
Video or screenshot: controller stick/button test to confirm no drift and all buttons work.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5 console and one controller, but they do not show the FIFA disc or the full accessory list, and they provide no proof the console/disc drive works. Without that, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
